caption: The drawing features a highly ornate wagon or parade cart viewed from the side. The wagon is richly decorated with elaborate carvings and figures, primarily in gold colors, accented with red, white, and blue. The background of the main panel shows a stylized American flag with red and white stripes and a blue field with stars. In the center, beneath a large golden arch and an eagle with a shield, is a prominent standing female figure draped in classical robes, flanked on both sides by additional figures: to her left, a male figure holding a trident and a female figure in draped garments, and to her right, another male and female figure in classical attire. On the left and right ends of the wagon, within their own ornate frames, stand more carved figures: a female in flowing robes on the left and a male riding a horse on the right. Between and around these figures are intricate scrolling floral patterns and a pair of cherubs, one on each side. The wagon has two large wheels, each with red and white spokes and a blue central hub. Ornamental gold detailing runs along the upper edge of the wagon. At the center bottom, a banner with the words "UNITED STATES" is visible, integrated into the decorative scrollwork. The entire composition uses a palette dominated by gold, red, white, and blue on a light background.
title: Circus Wagon
